In his book (

Journeys in Islamic Countries

After hearing these explanations about the ‘spirit’ and the ‘soul’, and

the ‘mind’ and ‘thought’, Sir John Bennett later said:

“

So ended our first discussion. I still do not know what to say except

that he is a very good and a very sincere man who is truly turned

toward God. But what he understands or does not understand, that

I cannot say

”

.

Dear reader:

Don’t you think that what we hear is completely new, and totally strange

?

Have people ever heard anything like this before? Have they heard of such noble meanings? Shouldn’t such supreme meanings be adopted by those who have an atom of thinking and who put aside all false desires considering God as their companion!

chapters.title: Chapter 3
chapters.html:
The Justice of God ﴿8﴾

-The house of the great scholar Mohammad Amin Sheikho

The First Session Was Over

Sir Bennett

: After this session, I want you to accept me as a guest in your house. After I had heard a knowledge unknown by humanity before from you, the rules of conduct impose that the junior goes to the senior and the student to the tutor.

Our great scholar

: You are warmly welcome, but wasn’t that your question?

Sir Bennett

: No. What I asked was test questions I ask to the scholars, If I am answered with logic and wisdom, then I ask my main and important question. If I am not answered well, I suffice myself with what I had heard and withdraw.

Sir Bennett promised to be in the house of our great Scholar at 10 a.m. next morning. The meeting was held on time.

Our great Scholar warmly welcomed him as a dear honorable guest. Then Sir Bennett asked the permission to ask his question which had been very difficult for him and for the other scientists and scholars, saying:

I looked at the sky with a deep contemplation and saw huge celestial bodies, strange stars and planets, a magnificent accurate system of a perfect creation and steering, so I was absolutely sure that there must be a great Creator and an Almighty Steering God who directs and organises all these in a strict discipline.

Then I looked at the earth, and what a terrible situation I saw! great injustice, the rich and the poor, the black and the white, oppressors and oppressed, the tall and the short, the beautiful and the ugly, the healthy and the ill, the happy and the miserable, this encroaches on that, and that steals from this, the strong kills the weak, and states contain states, then I judged that there is no God, no Creator nor Arranger.

If God is there in the sky and He is the Organiser and Controller, why does not He exist on earth as an Organiser and Director? When I see injustice on earth, I deny the existence of God.

Either a God who is supervising, controling, Omniscient, seeing everyone and Omnipresent or injustice.

“Either there is injustice, and no God, or there is God, and no injustice”.

This is my question. What is your reply?

Our great Scholar

: Do you want a direct answer and then the details, evidences and events, or shall we conclude the answer as a result?

Since he was interested in his question and keen to have an answer, Sir Bennett wanted to hear a direct answer and then the elucidation and details. Our great Scholar replied him decisively saying:

“God exists and there is no injustice at all”.

Sir Bennett

"surprised and astonished":

“What do you say”? There is no injustice at all? Please explain in details.

Our great Scholar

: The Almighty Creator and the great Director exists in the sky and on earth.

He is in the sky with His Bright Beauty and on earth with His Compassion. Every single motion is by His Omniscience and Direction, and the strict discipline, perfect steering and indefinite precision in the sky exist on earth too, and there is no Creator but God who has created and directed all creatures in heaven and on earth so there is no injustice at all.

God says in the Holy Qur’an:

“It is He who is God in heaven and God on earth. And He is the All Wise and Omniscient.”

The Holy Qur'an,

Fortress ﴿43﴾ Az-Zukhruf (Ornaments of Luxury), verse ﴿84﴾ .

Man came to this world after promising his Provider that he would recognize Him, be guided by His light and never stop directing himself towards Him. He would carry out good deeds and charity to all His creatures and the obedients. When man came to this life and God covered his spirit with a bodily garment and gave him the choice, he forgot his promise to God, deviated from his humanity and the straight path which he had promised to follow. God’s mercy did not leave this human being in this mess; He provided him with thought and distinguished him from all His creatures. He also provided him with hearing, vision and senses.

He put in his hands cosmic miracles such as the stars, planets, the sun, the moon, rain and fruit to direct him if he thinks and considers. They will guide him to the Almighty God, as they did with Abraham and his brothers, the messengers. Through death which takes away his beloved and relatives, God meant to waken him from his transitory satisfaction and his false arrogance in order to uplift his humanity, achieve his perfection and acquire paradises.

God also sent man the Noble Messengers to remind him, and the angels to warn him. He made man laws and rules to organize all aspects of his life. But, Alas despite the mercy, love and kindness, that God granted to man he deviated from the path leading to his happiness and real eternal life.

He became absorbed in his bohemian lusts, to hurt, kill, steal and rob Al’lah-obedients, yet he wouldn’t be able to kill, steal or hurt but those who had previously killed, stolen and hurt the ones weaker than they were.

Therefore, God gives a free hand to the oppressor against an oppressor, while there is no authority to anyone on him who is following strictly the straight path of right and humanity within the orders of the Almighty God.

In the Holy Qur’an, God says:

“What can Al’lah gain by your punishment if ye are grateful offering good acts, and ye believe yet Al’lah is Thankful and Omniscient”

The Holy Qur'an,

Fortress ﴿4﴾ An-Nesa (The Women), verse ﴿147﴾ .

Out of the Merciful’s mercy and the Wise’s wisdom, this oppressor is not left to do whatever he wants, so God inflicts him with disasters, hardships, diseases, poverty, hunger, and deprivation.

God the Almighty says:

“And indeed we will make them taste of the lightest chastisement before the greatest chastisement in order that they may (repent and) return”.

The Holy Qur'an,

Fortress ﴿32﴾ As-Sajda (The Prostration), verse ﴿21﴾ .

God let these oppressors taste the torture in this world so that they may repent, return to their Provider and stop the injustice they do to themselves. God does not empower an oppressor to himself but on another oppressor to himself too, so that he may awaken from his inadvertence and withdraw from his tyranny and aggression.

All this is done through the Omniscience and wisdom of the Almighty God and in a way similar to the degree of his inadvertence. These disasters are hard enough to make the oppressor to himself awaken from his inadvertence so they are not evil to them, they are mercy and goodness. The situation is similar to that of the teacher or father who lay stresses on their lazy or careless pupils or sons. Such stress and embarrassment are but mercy, kindness and love, they are not oppression, violence or revenge.

God the Almighty says:

“Say: O God of all! Possessor of the possession (creation of power and rule). Thou givest possession

and power to who thou pleasest.

And thou strippest off possession and power from whom thou pleasest. Thou enduest with honour whom thou pleasest. And thou bringest low whom thou pleasest. In thy hand is nothing but goodness. Verily, over all things thou hast, Thou are Omnipotent”.

The Holy Qur’an,

Fortress ﴿3﴾ Al 'Imran (The Family of 'Imran), verse ﴿26﴾ .

I.e. only the goodness is in the hand of God to whom He gives, deprives, cherishes or humiliates, with what suits him for his good.

Similar to this is the doctor who may be forced to cut open the abdomen of his patient to take out his ailment. He sometimes deprives his patient of many pleasures. The behaviour of the father, teacher or doctor towards these, might be seen from two different points of view.

The first is a feeling of injustice, cruelty and mercilessness when we do not know the reasons.

The second is a relief and blessing if we know that what they did was but for the benefit of those people.

The hard-working student, obedient son and the Wiseman do not need such harassments, stresses or torture. This is God’s aim from disasters.

It is a part of His mercy and a trace of his love to His creatures. Therefore, the pain, suffering and evil seen by the people are but remedies to those sick-spirited people.

The treatment differs according to the disease. Some are greedy for money; they need diet, so God impoverishes them because money cannot make them good. Some like to be arrogant unjustly, and they use their might to oppress others, so God deprives them of that, and if they go far in their infidelity without being able to return to God and the disasters have no good effect, Al’lah opens to them the gates of this world and then He suddenly takes them. After that they discover that they were misled. Some maintain no use in treatment because they desire nothing but the lower life, so God gives them what they want of this world. When God gives them, He gives them their desires, and they completely get involved in their lusts although they do not encroach on the freedom of those who differ with them and they do not oppress the others.

These are the people and masters of this world. They are fully given their demands and desires here, but hereafter they have no share, because they rejected it, and their utmost aim was this world and nothing else.

God says in the Noble Qur`an:

“But when they forgot the warning they had received, We opened to them the gates of all (good) things until in the midst of their enjoyment of our gifts, on a sudden, We called them to account, when lo! they discovered that they had mistaken the path of paradise for that of hell”.

The Holy Qur'an,

Fortress ﴿6﴾ Al-An'am (Livestock), verse ﴿44﴾ .

“Of the bounties of thy Provider, We bestow freely on all these as well as those; the bounties of thy Provider, None are deprived of”.

The Holy Qur'an,

Fortress ﴿17﴾ Al-Isra' (The Night Journey), verse ﴿20﴾ .

The believer may suffer from some adversities but the aim is expiation and promotion. In order that he does not lean on the lower world, there must have been something wrong done by him, and its evil has recourse on him. If he has not done wrong, he will suffer no harm. God wants this human being to have guidance voluntarily, i.e. by his own will and choice, because there is no use if the human being is driven by force to what he hates. True guidance is achieved when the human being voluntarily and by his own accord accepts what happens to him, and then he sees the goodness and justice of God and feels mercy and love flooding on the whole existence.

God says:

“Be sure We shall test you with something of fear and hunger, some loss in goods, lives and the fruits (of your toil) but give glad tidings t

o those who patiently preserve.

Who say when afflicted with calamity, To Al’lah we recourse and to Him is our repentance”.

The Holy Qur'an,

Fortress ﴿2﴾ Al-Baqara (The Cow), verses (155-156).

The disaster hits the target and these calamities are afflicted so that this human being resorts to his Provider, thinks why God sends them to him and searches for his sins and wrong doings, then he sees what has been wrong, determines to stop doing evil and repents.

However, there is no injustice in the universe. The one whose funds have been stolen, must have gained this money illegitimately by, fraud and cheating. The killed also must have previously killed someone, and the adulterer is driven to the adulteress, and the oppressor is driven to the oppressor.

God says:

“The adulterer cannot have sexual relation with any but an adulteress or an idolatress, and the adulteress, none can have sexual relations with her but an adulterer or idolater, to the Believers such a thing is forbidden

”

.

The Holy Qur'an,

Fortress ﴿24﴾ An-Nur (Light), verse ﴿3﴾ .

Over the pure good one who does good, no one has control.

God says:

“What does Al’lah gain by your punishment, If ye are grateful and ye believe?”

The Holy Qur'an,

Fortress ﴿4﴾ An-Nesa (The Women), verse ﴿147﴾ .

“And women of purity are for men of purity, And men of purity are for women of purity”.

The Holy Qur'an,

Fortress ﴿24﴾ An-Nur (Light), verse ﴿26﴾ .

§§§§§§§§§§

By deeds, mankind is divided into three kinds:

1-

Humanist.

2-

Those who do wrong to themselves “oppressors” and they act in a brutal way to achieve their whims.

3-

Those who do wrong to themselves “oppressors” and they act in a devilish manner to achieve their low and mean whims.

Nowadays, the humanist is very rare, and there remain the oppressor and the more oppressive. God alone has the good for the beneficent and the injurious alike, and the one who does not witness this in this world will witness it hereafter. Since the matter is so, there is no injustice among the people and since there is no injustice, there is no evil.

What we consider as evil is but sheer goodness to the afflicted one, because this evil will save him from a greater one, and this evil would not have occurred to him if he had not done something bad. Opening the belly is an evil to the healthy person, but it is good for the one who suffers from an ailment. Injustice is done only to the one who deserves it, and the oppressor directs his oppression only to someone like him.

God says:

“Thus We let some of the wrong-doers have power over others because of what they are wont to earn”

.

The Holy Qur'an,

Fortress ﴿6﴾ Al-An'am (Livestock), verse ﴿129﴾ .

By that disaster, he might retreat from his tyranny and remember his sin, then totally repent to God. Then injustice vanished, and God the Almighty might let him have power over that who had oppressed him.

This behavior is not only limited to the individuals but also applies to the nations and peoples. The nation which has a capability for faith more than another one, will suffer from the injustice of a more oppressive one by God’s order so that it might plead to God and stop its evils, so it returns to God.

God says:

“Say: He is able to send punishment upon you from above you or from beneath your feet, or to bewilder you with dissension and make you taste the tyranny, of one another. See how We display the revelation so that they may understand the truth”

.

The Holy Qur'an,

Fortress ﴿6﴾ Al-An'am (Livestock), verse ﴿65﴾ .

Then God changes their sins into good deeds and will give power to the oppressed, not to attack with violence and revenge, but to make it return to the straight path of right and goodness.

God says:

“And was it so, when a disaster smote you, though ye had smitten (with a disaster) twice (as great) that ye said: How is this? Say (unto them, o Mohammad): It is from yourselves. Lo! Al’lah is Omnipotent.”

The Holy Qur’an,

Fortress ﴿3﴾ Al 'Imran (The Fhmily of 'Imran), verse ﴿165﴾ .

God’s mill grinds slow but sure. When man commits disobedience, its punishment is registered unto him, if he repents and changes the evil inside him, God stops this catastrophe. If he does not repent or does not change what is inside him and continues his aggression, God will send him a greater disaster so that he might stop his evil and return to the path of goodness.

Here are some examples:

If a student is hard working and performs his duties in the best way, does his teacher punish him?

Of course not. He must be granted love, generosity and gifts.

Another student is negligent and does not do anything, he won’t thrive, and he is hopeless. The teacher might neglect him as there is no use of making him study. Dismissing him is better, as he may develop a profession.

A third is negligent sometimes and hardworking at other times. The teacher’s mercy might require punishment so as to make him work hard and be successful.

Suppose a patient had a dangerous chronic disease and there is no hope of his recovery. Does the doctor take care of him or he says to his family take him away and let him eat and drink whatever he wants until he dies because of his certain death? Another patient who suffers from something curable, the doctor will take care of him, treat him and may deprive him of eating some delicious food, and give him the suitable medicines.

Now, does a doctor give a person who is healthy and stout medicine or bitter cures? Does he make him a surgical operation or deprive him of delicious food and drink?

Of course not.

In the Holy speech, God says:

“O my obedient, seek Me and you shall find Me. If you find Me, you will find everything, and if you miss Me, you have missed everything and to you, I am the most loved of everything” ﴿8﴾

“O my obedient, be for Me as I wish and I will be for you as you wish”

.

God the Almighty wants us to be straight and thus He protects us from every evil. He will always be with the straight one, supporting, helping and protecting him.

God says in the Noble Qur`an:

“And Al’lah will not give the disbelievers any way (of success) against the believers”.

The Holy Qur'an,

Fortress ﴿4﴾ An-Nesa (The Women), verse ﴿141﴾ .

And in verse ﴿147﴾ of the same fortress, God says:

“What concern hath Al’lah for your punishment if ye are thankful (by good actions for his graces) and believe (in Him)”

?

God says:

“If ye give good acts thanking Me, I will give you more (of my graceful gifts).”

The Holy Qur'an,

Fortress ﴿14﴾ Ibrahim (Abraham), verse ﴿7﴾ .

Thanking in this verse means but good deed.

In verse 13 of (Saba') Fortress, God says:

“Give good deeds to thank me, O House of David!”

If man keeps away from his Provider, or denies the graces of God, he will undoubtedly be deprived of the graces of God on the day of Resurrection.

Al’lah wants good for man, and has prepared the paradises for him. By keeping himself away from his Provider, man deprived himself of such gifts and did injustice to it. As he wished for lusts and vices, God gave them to him and expelled him from this world insulted and defeated. The one who wants this lower world is given that, but he will have nothing on the day of Resurrection.

The one who mixes a good act with an evil one, whose faith is weak and his good deeds are very few shall go to hell which is a bad abode. God’s mercy requires afflicting them with disasters and trouble and letting others oppress them in order to make them repent and resort to their God Since they have the ability to be good. God then stops their torment and other disasters when they repent and resort to Him, and by that they become happy here and hereafter.

God says:

“If only there had been a community (of all those that were destroyed of old) that believed and profited by its belief as did the folk of Jonah! When they believed, We drew off from them the torment of shame in the life of this world and gave them comfort for a while”

.

The Holy Qur'an,

Fortress ﴿10﴾ Yunus (Jonah), verse ﴿98﴾ .

God does not change people’s condition until they themselves change. If they change, they will find a Forgiving and Merciful God, Who will inevitably make them enjoy life in this world and hereafter. God is of great grace over mankind although most of them do not know.

When Quraish asked Prophet Mohammad (cpth) such a question and wondered surprisingly where this great man brought this great indication that there is no God but Al’lah from, although he had not studied at a school or university, where he brought this knowledge and science which had spread all over the world and made him the merciful spiritual father, great tutor, genius leader who built the minds of the leaders and masters of this world, the healing doctor, knowledgeable, perfect social reformer, intelligent politician, the refiner of spirits, manners and morals, the genuine sage, the one who filled this worldly existence and the afterlife with human perfection and noble acts, the perfect, gracious one who was not taught by a human being and was an orphan grazing sheep on Mecca’s mountain passes.

His God instructed him: O Mohammad, tell them saying I

“seek refuge in the Provider of oblivious (mankind)” ﴿9﴾

.

While you seek refuge in the creature and what a great difference it is! I sought refuge in Him, therefore He taught, supported, guided me and inspired something very weighty to be told to you. If the jinns and mankind assembled to do something similar they will fail.

I take refuge in the King Provider of oblivious (mankind) who created you and gave you hearing, vision, taste and touching, gave you the treasures and fruits of this world, took care of you and brought you up while you were embryos in the wombs of your mothers, gave you all luxury and perfectly brought you up. Then they asked him why God created this man short and that tall, this rich and that poor, this white and that black, this good looking and that ugly. God told the prophet: say to them He is

“The King of oblivious (mankind)”

. They are all fully in His hands, and He gives each what suits him. They said:

Since God is Merciful and He is our Possessor, why does not He make us enter Paradise, and what for fire is. God told him, Say to them He is

“the steering God of the oblivious (mankind)”

who directs them according to their choice to what suits them for their benefit. God directs your deeds according to your choice.

If you pay heed and follow His orders, you will be happy here and hereafter; you will get the blessings hidden for you surpassing all other creatures which are the supreme paradises, but if you disobey and continue committing sins, do what you want and insist on it, He will guide you according to your choice and then you will be responsible for all the results because you will lose everything here and hereafter, and you will choose fire to taste, then, to decrease your spiritual torture and the pain of your eternal loss. How hard will the hopeless life of the hereafter be!

§§§§§§§§§§

Sir Bennett admitted the grace of this great man after hearing and witnessing the proofs and evidences, events and stories confirming the truth and rejecting the existence of injustice.

All facts seemed clear to Sir Bennett, who confessed there facts and seemed as if taken by surprise and admiration. All suspicions and contradictions vanished from his mind.

It is time for this deep darkness and absolute ignorance to vanish because sun has risen to enlighten the worlds of earth and heaven. The hearts of the scientists were fascinated by his lights and brightness. The mighty philosophers and scientists of the world were bewildered by his knowledge and great deeds.

§§§§§§§§§§

After Sir Bennett had got the reply to his question, he dwelt for many days as a guest in his tutor’s house, asking, learning and enquiring about what crossed his mind. He began to ask about Islam and its pillars, about fasting, pilgrimage and Zakat (alms giving) and the wisdom behind each.

Once, he entered his host’s room and found him performing the communication with God with some of his disciples. He participated in the communication with God without taking his shoes off. When they finished, his tutor was surprised and asked him about his communication with God with the Muslims without washing his body and without ablution, Sir Bennett:

You spoke to me about communication with God and said it is the link between man and his Provider and the close enlightenment of God illumination. It is a combination of feelings, tastes, scenes and a peerless happiness. I have achieved this kind of communication with God.

His tutor told him that he had really communicated with God and that he was heartedly in communication with Him, but everything has a form and reality. He said to him: you have got the core and the truth, you left the dish and got the food, and God has accepted your communication, but the form helps. Ablution and washing refresh the body and the communication with God becomes complete; the form (the rite) and the reality, reality should have a form and the form should have a reality.

Sir John Bennett

: I told you how I had been awakened in the night and the conclusions I had reached.

Scholar Sheikho

: Now I can see that Al’lah really loves you. He sends His angels to direct your path.

He then turned to one of his pupils sitting on the floor beside them and said something in Arabic that Sir John Bennett could not follow.

Then he turned to Sir John Bennett and said:

Scholar Sheikho

: I told him that I would not exchange my meeting with you for ten million pounds. It does more good to meet a friend of Al’lah than all the wealth in the world.

chapters.title: Sir John Bennett said in
chapters.html:
his book that he set out to apply the way of belief so as to achieve knowledge of God.

From ( Journeys in Islamic Countries) – J. G. Bennett

He said:

-

Last night I wrestled with all my strength to accomplish the inner work I had given myself. It was as difficult a half hour as I have ever known. When it was over, I went straight to bed and slept until 3:00 a.m. I awoke very clear in my head and decided to meditate upon the chief problem of my existence. For two hours I kept this problem in front of me and prayed most earnestly for light. During that time, many things were shown to me and in the end I could see my way clearly.

-

Among other things, I understood just how far I could go with Emin Bey and where I had to stop and continue on my own way, alone except for the guidance that comes to me from within.

-

The chief difficulty with Emin Bey arises from his very goodness and purity. Here is in truth a saintly man who is utterly obedient to the Will of Al’lah as he understands it. He is doing and has done very much good. He is a faithful guide and example to his murids (pupils).

-

I wrote that his very goodness is the difficulty. If he were an ordinary man, however learned he might be, I should not even trouble to spend hours discussing theology, but Emin Bey is not an ordinary man. He is a saint and he has the supranormal powers of a saint.

Therefore, one must accept him and try to understand.

chapters.title: Sir John Bennett talked in his book about this meeting, saying:
chapters.html:
From ( Journeys in Islamic Countries) – J. G. Bennett

-

I was indeed very glad because it showed me that Emin himself is a “friend of Al’lah.”

-

We spoke first about the inner work, and I was very satisfied with the way he explained a difficulty I have met. Indeed, he put his finger on a great deficiency in my work that I have long wished to remedy. I have no longer any doubt that Emin really knows about work, and that he is able to transmit the teaching to his pupils. All the same, I am forced also to recognize the limitations of his world outlook. As I listen to Emin Bey’s explanations about inner work, I marvel; he is a real master. Not only has he achieved being for himself; but he can show others the way and give them the strength and courage to follow it.

-

I watched the murids carefully and could see that they were really impressed by what they heard. I was told afterwards that all of them have passed through secondary school and many have been to the university. About one third are themselves secondary school teachers or university lecturers. I mention this here because it is important to realize that these murids are not ignorant peasants but men who have at least some knowledge of Western thought. Indeed, these murids have risen to their doctrine in all their actions. Even Emin Bey himself bore uncountable troubles for my sake. He is a really good man. The saying that a teacher is known by his pupils is in his favor, for all I have met have a remarkable mutual love and sincerity.

-

Anyhow, tonight he said that he would not exchange ‘all London and America’ for the joy of having met me. He said that henceforward we are brothers and that I may go away to London, but his heart will go with me.

-

He must have spoken to his pupils about me in fairly strong terms, for I can see the respect they feel toward me. Indeed, he said in front of several of them tonight that in all Damascus, there was not one Muslim as near to God as I am!

-

As an example of his murids’ faith in him I will cite what one of his murids told me of a dream he had about a year ago – just at the end of ten years of close work with Emin Bey, whom he always calls ‘my guide’. He dreamed that he was sitting in his open court with a few murids, as they do on Fridays, and Emin Bey was, as usual, expounding on the Qur’an. As he was speaking, a young man came in who was very beautiful and took his seat to the right of Emin Bey. That murid said, “I knew that this was our prophet but no one made any special sign, and he began to explain to us the meaning of the word ‘takwa’ which most of the ulema (religious experts) explain as fear of God. He said that ‘takwa’ is the state that is reached in prayer when the soul gives itself entirely to God, who then opens its eyes and enables it to see the truth of good and evil. In this state of seeing, the soul cannot commit any wrong action. As I listened to this explanation, I was filled with joy, because our guide has told us exactly the same. So I knew that our guide is a true Teacher, because we are taught that a vision of the prophet must be authentic since Satan can never assume the form of the prophet and deceive men. It is evident, moreover, that he has been inspired by this explanation from God.”

-

And yet, in spite of that, this man can inspire belief in his murids.

He is an altogether extraordinary man in himself, and no one who

has been as close to him as I have can possibly doubt the reality of

the impulses of faith, hope and love within him.

Sir Bennett professed Islam and dwelt for 19 days performing the rituals established upon real wisdom of his new faith. Then he went to Britain and began giving lectures elucidating the greatness of this man and his scientific proofs. The hearers were university professors in the universities of Britain and America.

Before leaving to Britain he asked our great Scholar to accompany him and to take over any post, saying that in Britain, they would appreciate his knowledge and give him whatever he wanted.

Our Scholar apologized saying: “It is true you are going to give me everything in this world, but what about the guarantee of the hereafter, do you guarantee it?

Sir Bennett understood that the Scholar’s departure was impossible. Sir Bennett then tried with the Scholar’s son thinking that if the son left, his father would follow him, but he failed too.

Sir Bennett left Damascus alone by land through Turkey where he met a number of Moslem scholars.

They argued for a long time, and then he requested them to explain and interpret verse ﴿15﴾ of Al-Hajj Fortress (The Pilgrimage):

“If any thinks that Al’lah will not help him in this world and the Hereafter, let him do the good and the favour and stop the evils and bad acts, then let him see whether his plan and good deed will remove that which enrages him”

They answered him that the one who thinks that Al’lah will not help him should stretch a rope to his ceiling and put an end to his life by hanging himself and see after that if this would remove what enrages him. They said that this is stated in the famous interpretations.

Here Sir Bennett felt confused and directly sent to our Scholar informing him of what happened to him in Turkey, and asked him to interpret that verse.

Our great Scholar sent him the following reply with the correct meaning of the verse as meant in the Holy Qur’an:

"If you abide by it, God will drive away worries and grief, follow this and you will be happy. You might say: Why does God afflict me with disasters? Imagine a father who had an ill son; would he try his best to cure him or not? God is Merciful and Caring. If you get ill, will He try to cure you or not?

“If any thinks that Al’lah will not help him in this world and the Hereafter”

If that is his belief

“Let him lend a hand for his supremacy”

i.e. let him do good and favor

“Then to stop”

i.e. committing evil or bad deeds

“Then let him see if that will remove what enrages him”

Doesn’t his conduction and good deeds remove what enrages him!"

When Sir Bennett reached his country, he spoke about his visit to Damascus and his meeting with our great Scholar in his first lecture. He praised this honourable man and said that he had heard new and true things which the sciences and scientists all over the world were unable to tell something similar to what he had heard and seen from him.

The speeches of Sir Bennett were published in the British and French magazines and were distributed all over the world.

An edition reached Beirut and a student of our Scholar who was a doctor at the American University got a copy.

§§§§§§§§§§

Where did this great Scholar get his scientific knowledge from? He got it from his Creator as he devoted his spirit and sacrificed his soul and body to His creatures.

Twentieth Century Miracle

The Sources of Spring Water in the World

Let us now witness a firebrand of the knowledge of this honourable Scholar relating to the great scientific theory:

Dear reader:

Don`t you like to accompany us in a conceptual, sublime and intellectual journey? Don`t you want to add to your information something new, i.e. a science and a truth which the humankind of the era of atom and the moon visit, could not disclose with all the appliances and electronic equipment? Don`t you like to be with us at the door of a puzzle which astonished the scientists, geographers and researchers?

A puzzle which bewildered them until one began to pray saying:

“O God, where is the answer?”

This puzzle which made geographers, researchers and scientists unable to dissolve is the water which you and I drink and there is no life without it.

What is the source of this water? Where does it come from? How?

Let us go together and investigate where this fresh water comes from? Who sends it to us and how?

§§§§§§§§§§

After science has overtaken us and after civilization has invaded us, it is better to leave the noise and the smoke of the factories and cars and go on a journey on the ship of the mind to investigate the truth at the South and North Poles; the farthest boundaries of our world. It is an interesting exciting journey with good scenes, dazzling whiteness and excellent artistic paintings created by the Almighty God, and nothing disturbs that except the severe cold.

The North Pole is an area of more than 14 million square kilometers. This number is more than 65 times the area of Syria. Vast areas of glacial mountains, ice and glacial deserts. Who has created this wonderful painting?

You are like me, longing to know how these snows were formed. Where did they come from?

Under what circumstances were they formed and who is behind all this?

Were they formed by themselves? Has the East or the West with their sciences and civilizations formed them? Is there a merciful hand that takes care of you and me that has created all this? Is there any movement without a moving hand?

Cannot we say to the scientists of this world and civilization: where are your sciences? Where is your civilization? Answer us before you invade the space and make mass destructive weapons to kill the innocent and dominate the weak. Answer us where this water, which our life and yours depend on comes from before you think and feel proud of sciences which destroy the mankind. Has God created you for destruction and demolition or to fill this world with justice, mercy, tolerance, sympathy, humanity and kindness?

Let us my dear brother continue our journey to the North Pole where there are snows, glacial mountains and deserts, where there we find the severe cold and strong storms. The sun rays are inclined at the North and South Poles in order to give a very low heat. It is very cold and the temperature sometimes goes down to 85 degrees centigrade under zero. Generally snow falls and there are strong winds with severe glacial storms that make visibility come to nothing.

Life is very difficult and almost impossible. ﴿9﴾

-Summer solstice at the Antarctic

The day and night last for months every year because of the inclination of the axis of the earth. The sun does not set in the polar summer period. ﴿10﴾

-The sun does not set in the polar summer period, and it can even be seen at midnight.

It can be seen at midnight, and when it is summer on one Pole, it is winter on the other. Because there is no sun, darkness prevails in the morning and in the evening for a few months. The Antarctica is wider and colder for ice and snow. The speed of winds is sometimes about 350 Km per hour. Heat average in the Antarctica is few degrees less than it is in the Arctic Pole. Winter is severe and merciless. Many tried to explore the Antarctica but they failed. The Antarctica; the frozen continent, is a waste continent in which snows reach 5000 meters high.

All these conditions:

the dim light, severe cold and strong storms formed these snows and snowy mountains. Snow continues to fall day and night all the year round. What does this mean? It means that in the course of tens, and hundreds of years great amounts of snow will accumulate until they reach great heights which exceed thousands of meters across the polar area.

We all know that the two polar areas constitute two vast continents of the seven continents of the world. In the course of years, the two polar continents will dominate the other continents and change them into one snowy block, and consequently there will be no life.

Why did not this happen? Why didn`t the polar areas increase in height and expansion? Why did they keep their level and did not exceed it for thousands of years?

A continuous fall of snow and no increase, why? Where does this falling snow go? Where does it hide, and how? No one in the world, a genius scientist or researcher or an ordinary man could disclose the secret of the fate of these snows. Is this reasonable? Y

es.

Dear reader:

If you lose precious jewels, is it possible that they disappear by themselves or someone has disposed of them?

What hand has made and disposed of those mountains, glacial steppes and Poles?

How do these vast districts of which the area is thousands of square kilometers

of ice move?

What is that power whi

ch moves them? What is it like

?

Is it mechanical or hydraulic, prop

ellant, sucking or centrifugal?

How great is the astonishing Power that moves them?

All the polar area, with its vastness and volume drifts is carried away.

The Norwegian scientist

“Nansen”

who went to the North Pole area on board the ship

“Fram”

which was detained among the ice there at the end of the 19th century proved this drift ﴿10﴾

. ﴿11﴾

-The Norwegian explorer Fridtjof Nansen

“Nansen”

wanted to prove to the world that the polar ice drifts slowly across the North Pole Ocean. This was evidenced to him when his ship

“Fram”

left the ice on the other side of the frozen Ocean in 1896 although it was blocked by ice in 1893. This proved that the whole Pole area drifts.

How does this vast area drift?

Who makes it drift? Why and what for?

Does that happen in play, capriciously or by accident?

In the Holy Qur`an, God says:

“We created not the heavens, the earth and all between them merely in play”

.

The Holy Qur'an,

Fortress ﴿44﴾ Ad-Dukhan (Smoke), verse ﴿38﴾ .

Let us study the books of science so that we may reach something…

Let us go to Greenland ﴿12﴾

-Map of Greenland

Natural scientist

“Franklin Russels”

wrote a scientific report about an amazing scientific phenomenon. He and other Eastern and Western scientists noticed that at an area of the North Pole near Greenland Island, 8000 icebergs are formed yearly as evidenced by the computer

.

God says in the Noble Qur`an:

“…Renewing white mountains…”

The Holy Qur'an,

Fortress ﴿35﴾ Fatir (Orignator), verse ﴿27﴾ .

They are

moved by the winds and storms.

5000 icebergs of them reach Melvil Bay

.

The human science stood incapable at the disappearance of 3000 icebergs in the unknown under fog and in t

he very dark winter atmosphere.

-Eight-ninths of the iceberg remain submerged beneath the surface of the water

Don`t you want to know the answer? Don`t you want to know the source of your drinking water? The installation of these springs from which you drink? This water is sent to you with no change from your Merciful Almighty God.

Where does this ice of which the diameter exceeds 4000 kilometers if there are no drains or ways out? Won`t it cover the earth? Won`t it put an end to life? Does this nature think? Does it arrange its own affairs? Does it evaporate the sea water or grow the plants? Does it make rain and snow fall at certain times? What is this nature, and who made it?

§§§§§§§§§§

Dear reader: ﴿14﴾

-Picture of some fresh water springs in the high Bsher'ri Mountain in Lebanon

We were in

Greenland

among the mountains, ice and snow and felt cold. We are now in need of the warmth of our country`s sun. Let us go to Lebanon and to the high “Bsharri Mountain”

where there are tens of water springs at about 3000 meters high, although the mountain is surrounded by the sea from one side and by hills and areas spreading thousands of Kilometers, they are lower than it, and water cannot ascend to high places. Who feeds these springs? Where do they ascend from?

We do not exaggerate if we say it is a great scientific theory and the human being who tried to solve it and gave an answer to it and to the other questions is really a great man. ﴿15﴾

-Jua`ita Cave in Lebanon

Let us also go to “Jeita Grotto”

in Lebanon where there are the stalagmites and the stalactites. It is a lake in a high mountain which has boats.

How are such lakes formed, yet what surrounds it is lower than it and water does not ascend from a low place to a high place.

There is also nothing that feeds it.

Then let us come back to our green land, to Damascus, the Land of the forefathers and the place of prophets; to the spring of “Al-Fijeh”

where there is that abundant cold water spring. Because of its coldness and clarity, you cannot keep your hand in the water but for seconds. From which refrigerator does it come from? It is from Almighty`s refrigerators.

It is from the Pole, from a Pole of which the area is more than 14 million square kilometers.

How does it come to us? How can we say that it is from the Pole? What is the proof on that? Where does Al-Fijeh spring which supplies the inhabitants of Damascus the capital, take its coldness from?

If the coldness is from the rains, the water will not be so cold, add to that when waterfalls, its temperature will go down one degree in every 100 meters, and these springs come to us from places which may be thousands of meters deep.

Where do these cold springs come from and how do they sometimes come from high places and mountains-tops, yet they are not fed by any tributary?

It is axiomatic that the polar snows always fall because they are fed from the evaporated waters of the seas. Sunrays pour and penetrate into it sucking some of its water in the form of small invisible drops of water vapour driven by the wind to form clouds which fall as rain later on. This means that the seas will lose huge quantities of their waters every year. These waters won`t return again to seas. They will accumulate as ice on the Poles.

In decades the oceans and seas will be dry. Why does not this take place? Have we seen sea withdrawal from Tartous` or Lattakia`s

shores?

How to solve this mystery, and has the twentieth century`s civilization solved it? Is it true that the rain water feeds all the springs and rivers?

These questions were answered by our great Scholar who has derived his knowledge and sciences directly from God when he asked Sir Bennett who was a scientist in natural science.

Have you, Eastern and western scientists, known the source of the water you drink and where is your spring provided from?

Sir Bennett replied that the rain waters are the main source of drinking water.

Our great Scholar replied him saying that the rain waters are for the plants and animals.

God says:

“…He let water fall from the sky. We thereby grew pairs of variable plants. Eat and graze your cattle…”

While God has made a different arrangement for the human being who is honoured by Him.

What is this arrangement then?

God says:

“He who made the earth a craddle for you and made under- ground ways of water to you…”

The Holy Qur'an,

Fortress

﴿20﴾ Taha (Taha = pure), verse (53-54).

Our Scholar asked Sir Bennett if there was a big river in Britain. Sir Bennett said of course, it is the Thames River

and big ships sail on it. ﴿16﴾

-The River Thames in Britain

The Scholar asked: Are the quantities of rain waters falling on Britain enough to feed that river all the year round?

Sir Bennett made some calculation according to the flow of the Thames and found:

Cubic meters

×

3600 per hour

×

24 hours per day

×

365 days per year.

He calculated the average quantity of rain falling on Britain and found that the rain waters falling on Britain will feed the river for only one week.

Here our great Scholar asked him: Where does the river Thames feed in the remaining 51 weeks from?

When Sir Bennett could not reply, our Scholar said:

“From the waters of the snow, bergs and ice of the Pole”

Sir Bennett asked in astonishment: How does this happen?

Our Scholar replied:

You know Sir Bennett that it snows in the Polar areas almost the year long and the sun`s rays are very dim and ineffective like the light of the moon.

If this ice and icebergs have no drains and wide apertures in the bottom of the frozen ocean, ice will accumulate to great heights and life will be impossible, in addition to the great pressure of the ice and icebergs on some parts of the bottom of the North icy ocean which its average depth is more than 3000 meters and also on the Antarctic area.

It is scientifically known that when we go 100 meters under the ground, the temperature increases one degree centigrade. But the spring waters come to us cold, fresh and pure, although they come from under the ground and from great depths that might reach thousands of meters.

According to the scientific laws, these waters should reach us hot because they get heat from the under-ground, but this does not happen. The great pressures of these icebergs on the huge apertures (drains) make the ice near the holes melt and the water goes down these hot passages rapidly. Heat, in the interior of the earth of the North and South Poles, helps the ice to melt and spout rapidly. After it melts, it branches to feed all the springs and rivers on the surface of our earth.

The fast continuous flow through the passages keeps the waters cold, and the high level of the Poles above the ground in addition to the axial inclination of the globe and its daily and yearly rotating around itself explains to us the ascent of water to the top of the mountains in the world which sometimes are more than 3000 meters high.

Some of these springs come to us directly from the Pole to the spring and this explains its high coldness; and some springs are less cold because its passages feed reservoirs in the mountains to feed less cold springs.

God says in the Holy Qur'an, Fortress ﴿21﴾ Al-Anbiya' (The Prophets), verse ﴿31﴾ .:

“We made anchors in the earth lest it tilts them, and We made in it deep passages, so that they might be guided”.

"We made anchors in the earth”

: mountains.

“lest it tilts them”

: so that its rotating doesn`t deviate and its surface doesn`t crack.

"We made in it deep passages”:

water reservoirs into the mountains which exits according to strict scales. Isn`t that an evidence of Al`lah existence?

“

Passages”

: i.e. springs. Big springs from the rivers, while small ones form springs, who made their underground ways?

"So that they might”

: if they give thought.

“Be guided”:

to Al`lah Himself and to know Him, if you don't give thought you will never be guided.

These springs and rivers keep their flow because they are permanently fed by the Pole through these passages. They come to us with regular fixed levels all the year long. In certain very short periods of time, the water level in the rivers gets high at the end of winter and the coming of spring because they are fed by the rain water and the melting of the ice in spring through the supplying reservoirs and then the river goes back to its level all the year long.

We see from what was mentioned above that there is a wonderful balance and very strict laws, made by the Merciful God, to control all these things without any contradiction in these natural laws.

A continuous flow from the springs and rivers met by a continuous accumulation of snow all the yearlong and within very accurate criteria which the human science could not disclose its secrets.

What great these polar reservoirs are! Who maintains and reforms them yearly for us and for our sake so that we might enjoy them and be honoured. What merciful and a lending hand supervises all this providence! Permanent generosity and pouring of love, compassion and Ruth. All for our sake yet we do not know.

God says:

"

We let water fall from the sky, and made you drink it, yet you are unable of reserving it”.

The Holy Qur'an,

Fortress ﴿15﴾ Al-Hijr (Stone Buildings), verse ﴿22﴾ .

Do you reserve it? If it rains in winter, whatever reservoirs you maintain, what do you do in summer? Have you thought of springs and the quantities of their water which flow all the yearlong? Don`t you give a thought to its reservoirs? Who has organized them? Where are their locations? Don`t they finish and reach an end? Think of that to achieve true faith.

§§§§§§§§§§

This fact surprised Sir Bennett and he replied saying that he wondered how this question had never crossed his mind before.

God Says:

"Hast you not seen how Al`lah hath sent down water from the sky and hath caused it to penetrate the earth as water springs".

The Holy Qur’an

Fortress ﴿39﴾ Az-Zumar (The Groups) verse ﴿42﴾ .

This holy verse proves that God sends these polar waters through passages under the ground.

Sweeping currents go under the sea waters, and the one called the North Atlantic Drift of which the speed is between five to six knots and which goes in the north eastern direction after leaving the American coasts does not exceed the waters near the surface.

It has no effect at about 350 meters deep. Also researchers found another great current called Golf Stream

in the opposite direction. The currents which have clear limits are called Golf Stream.

The world surface currents go with the clock in the north half of the earth, while they go in the opposite direction in the south half and are called “whirlpools”. In the north half of the earth, there are two severe whirlpools in the north of the Atlantic and Pacific Oceans, and in the south half, there are three whirlpools with an opposite direction in the south of the Pacific and Indian Oceans.

Under the water there are currents of which the direction may be opposite to the salty surface currents. These currents under the salty water across the sea are fresh water.

God the Almighty mentioned in the Holy Qur`an these sea currents of fresh cold waters which go under the salty waters of the Atlantic and Pacific oceans.

In The Holy Qur'an, Fortress ﴿24﴾ An-Nur (Light), verse ﴿40﴾ . showing that truth with an example denoting or concluding this truth, God says:

“Or (the unbelievers, state) is like the depth of darkness in a vast deep ocean, overwhelmed with billow topped by billow, topped by (dark) clouds, Depths of darkness above another”.

Al`lah says that the reality of this blind deviating man whose mind eye is not open who remains blind. At the doors of death he looks at his deeds and feels ashamed of them. They turn to be darkness and darkness as veils exactly like this very deep sea.

This holy verse is an example like others mentioned in the Holy Qur`an.

These examples are realities existing in this life, such as this holy verse ﴿13﴾ of Fortress ﴿36﴾ Ya Sin 'Ya-sin', (Safe & Pure):

“

Give them an example, the town inhabitants when God`s messengers were sent to them”.

It is beyond doubt that there was a town where God`s messengers were sent to.

Another holy verse ﴿17﴾ of Fortress ﴿2﴾ Al-Baqara (The Cow), verses ﴿17﴾ , is:

“They are like him who lit a fire”.

And the verse ﴿32﴾ of Fortress ﴿18﴾ Al-Kahf (The Cave), verse ﴿32﴾ :

“Give them an example; two men, we gave one of them two orchards...”

This verse applies to what takes place in the north and south of the Atlantic and pacific oceans which are the biggest and deepest oceans.

God said

“…the depth of darkness…”

which means very deep. There is no doubt that this is the deepest of the oceans and seas. Since it is known that water, and especially the salty wavy water, reflects the sun light, the deeper o

ne goes; the darker it becomes. ﴿17﴾

-Internal waves south of Java, NASA/GSFC-Real pictures of the waves overwhelming deep oceans thousands meters beneath their surfaces. These waves were discovered recently and humanity did not know

The second reference

“overwhelmed with billow topped by billow”

indicates two waves and undoubtedly they differ from each other. The upper waves are the waves of the salty water while the lower which flows fast is cold and fresh. The dark clouds reflect and hide the sun light, the salty water and the sweeping or lower cold water hides the fresh cold water under it. This increases the darkness. ﴿18﴾

-A current diagram of the Gulf Stream

Under the Golf stream

which goes north east along the eastern part of the USA, there is a big cold current of “Fresh Water” flowing from the North Pole area to the south on the north of the Atlantic Ocean. The Golf stream divides into two branches, the first goes along the east coast of Greenland

and north and south Europe, while the other branch goes to the south to continue its whirlpool in the north half of the earth. Surface cold currents usually go to the south.

In the south half of the earth, cold water runs around the polar area while their branches go north toward the tropical and semi tropical areas.

This explains to us the flow of the Nile and Orontes rivers

and others opposite the direction of the other rivers. This is quite clear in Syria because the name of “Orontes”

in Arabic means “rebellious”.

This means that the sources of the springs and river waters partly come from the ice of the North and South Poles. The rivers which flow from north to south come from the North Pole ice, and rivers of the opposite direction from south to north such as the Orontes and the Nile

come from the ice of the South Pole.

When these deep currents go across the seas coming from the Poles under deep layers of salty swift water, they pass without mixing and at the same time go to the places of their second spring to be as river, lakes and springs without mixing with the upper and surface salty or warm waters.

Springs of fresh water exist even in the deep areas in the Mediterranean and near the Greek coast of kornif, and in the Atlantic Ocean on the coast of Morocco

near Aghadear and in the peninsula of Florida.

In Arwad Island and Latakia area in Syria, fresh water comes from the bottom of the sea, because it is lighter in density and in weight than the salty water with which it does not mix. It goes up to the surface.

The sailors and fishermen use this water to increase their supply of fresh water.

God says:

"It is He who has let free two bodies of flowing water: one palatable and sweet, and the other salt and bitter, yet He has made a barrier between them. A partition that is not to be passed".

The Holy Qur'an,

Fortress ﴿25﴾ Al-Furqan (The Criterion), verse ﴿35﴾ .

1-

Very deep seas and lakes: At the top the salty sea waters while the fresh is below and between them (the partition is solid) which is the soil and the rocks of the crust such as in Arwad Island which is surrounded by the salty waters of the sea. Springs and wells of fresh water spring from under the sea. Here Almighty God made a partition between them. Fresh water is not mixed with the salty one; it goes from the interior of the earth under the salty sea. The partition is the ground of the sea bottom; it is a solid barrier on which the verse says:

“...He has made a barrier between them. A partition that is not to be passed”

In the mountains surrounding the seas, in the seas and in their interior, the partition is rocks and earth, i.e. solid such as the islands in the salty seas with fresh waters from beneath.

2-

The Gulf current and Labrador current, in addition to others of fresh water, the partition is watery, i.e. liquid “ It is He who has let free two bodies of flowing water, one palatable and sweet, and the other salt and bitter”.

3-

The Arctic; icebergs and fresh snows in the salty seas, the partition is watery, i.e. liquid.

4-

The Antarctica, icebergs and fresh snows surrounded by salty seas (solid). ﴿19﴾

-Surface ocean current map

The partition is solid consisting of rocks: A solid barrier and a partition that is not to be passed. It is a barrier for the waters to prevent them from mixing and uniting. It is barred by rocks.

Salty seas surround Antarctica while fresh waters go through passages under the ground of Antarctica then they flow through passages under the sea bottom to form big rivers and small springs in other islands, villages and elsewhere.

It is known that the deserts contain vast layers of water underneath. In the Grand Desert which is considered the largest desert of the world of which its area is more than the area of Europe, there is a basin underground containing more than 12000 cubic kilometers of water. This quantity is 40 times bigger than the water of Azov Sea. Where does this basin take its water from? Is it, as they say, from the rain water falling on the coasts of the Mediterranean; although it is 40 times bigger than Azov Sea?

There is no doubt that it takes its water from one of the polar continents.

In the ex-Soviet Union the layers rich in water including the artesian exists in Qara Qoum and Qaizeel Qoum and in other deserts. The largest artesian basin in the world is located on the west of Siberia between the Ural in the west and River Enese in the east. The area of this basin is more than 3 million square kilometers.

The largest artesian basin, also exists in the European side of the Soviet Union (Moscow and Danebro-Dontisk basins and others)

.

The fresh water of these huge basins cannot be logically said to be from the rain falls, but certainly from the adjacent north polar area.

§§§§§§§§§§

We can conclude that the polar areas are big reservoirs of our cold and pure drinking water, and the mountains are but branch reservoirs. The spring openings are firm (of changeless, fixed quantities of water) all the year round, and the rain and snow falling on our areas are only for the irrigation of our plants and the animals, but man is honoured by God so he drinks from the pure raging water of the polar areas. Look how much God favours us on many all other creatures.

In Fortress ﴿100﴾ Al-'Adi'yat (The Wind), verse (4-5):

4-“We transferred and maintained by it immersion,”

In Arabic “Atharna” means transferred and maintained; the last letter in Arabic which is (N) denotes the supreme merits of Almighty Al`lah i.e. His supreme Names containing Mercy, Charity, Kindness, Compassion in addition to other Perfect Merits.

“…by it…”

denotes that discipline that led to rainfall.

“….Immersion…”

refers to that gathering water.

5-“We made it in a medium location for all the living creatures”.

“Wasatna”,

which in

“made it in a medium location,”

The last letter in Arabic (N) denotes the supreme merits of Almighty Al`lah.

“...by it”

refers to the accumulating water. We can interpret this verse as follows:

God speaks about moving and keeping the water by his Mercy, Kindness, Love and Affection and that there is a system through which the rain falls, gathers together and makes that huge polar supply. He tells His creatures that out of H

HH

is Kindness, Love and Affection He carried the rain water and kept it in those huge reservoirs in the polar areas, He carried that collected water through certain passages running under the ground and at appropriate proportions which made the springs and rivers for your own good. Who maintains, cleans and reforms all these drains and underground passages of these polar waters?

These polar waters are let pass to every island, city and village all over the world with regular proportions all the yearlong for our own use?

None is steering and providing the universe but You, out of Your extreme Favour and abundant Generosity, Oh, Al`lah.

May God reward you, our great scholar all love, honouring, respect and reverence. You really deserve all honouring by your high supremacy, your love to God and your omniscience from God based upon witting. May Generous God lead us to it by His great Favour. He is very near, responding the prayer who

is communicating with you.

Al`lah says in The Holy Qur'an, Fortress ﴿2﴾ Al-Baqara (The Cow), verses ﴿282﴾ :

“...Be under Al`lah`s light, then it is Al`lah that teaches you...”

True praise is to You, Provider of all the worlds

§§§§§§§§§§

chapters.html:
Journeys in Islamic Countries

In his book, Journeys in Islamic Countries, Sir John Bennett mentioned his meeting with the Great Scholar M.

Amin

Sheikho and he talked very much in praise of his unique character, his humane deeds and his logical dialogue, saying, for example:

-

“So ends the first talk. I still do not know what to say except that he is very good and a very sincere man who is truly turned toward God. But what he understands or does not understand, that I cannot say.”

-

“Today we started by verifying certain things about work about which I shall not write, beyond saying that I have no doubt that Emin

Chikhou ﴿11﴾

has reached a certain level of inner work that I have rarely met before.”

-

“As I listen to Emin Bey’s explanations about inner work, I marvel; he is a real master. Not only has he achieved being for himself; but can show others the way and give them the strength and courage to follow it.”

-

“The chief difficulty with Emin Bey arises from his very goodness and purity. Here is in truth a saintly man who is utterly obedient to the Will of Al’lah as he understands it. He is doing and has done very much good. He is a faithful guide and example to his murids.”

-

“I wrote that his very goodness is the difficulty. If he were an ordinary man, however learned he might be, I should not even trouble to spend hours in discussion of theology. But Emin Bey is not an ordinary man. He is a saint and he has the supernormal power of a saint. Therefore, one must accept him and understand.”

-

“I was told that all of them have passed through secondary school and many have been to the university. About one third are themselves secondary school teachers or university lecturers.”

-

“I mentioned this because it is important to realize that these murids are not ignorant peasants but men who have at least some knowledge of Western thought.”

-

“I have no right to talk to Emin Bey as an equal about questions of religion unless I am prepared to make demands upon myself no less severe than he makes upon himself.”

-

“He is a really good man. The saying that a teacher is known by his pupils is in his favor, for all I have met have remarkable mutual love and sincerity.”

-

“Now I meet and talk with a real dervish, Emin Bey.”

-

“He is an altogether extraordinary man in himself, and of the reality in him of the impulses of faith, hope and love, no one who has seen him as closely as I have, can possibly doubt.”

-

“The more I see of him and hear from other of his works, the more convinced I am that he is truly a saint and that his interpretations of the Qur’an are inspired by a higher consciousness.”

-

“Meeting him has been a lesson to me in many ways: I see what wholehearted devotion to work can be. I see nobility of character and an immense power to attract and hold the love and faith of others.”

-

“Men like Emin Bey are very rare. He has sought God all his life,

and he had a real teacher. He is a man with real power of work and from it he has acquired real being.”

-

“For all his fundamentalism, Emin Bey is very tolerant and practical in his outlook. I believe that he truly listens to the heart and not to the spoken word.”

-

“But with this man I felt such a comradeship and assurance of beingfully understood and accepted that I told him things that I would not tell others.”

From Journeys in Islamic Countries

– J. G. Bennett

A Glimpse of the Life of the Eminent Scholar Mohammad Amin Sheikho

(His soul has been sanctified by Al’lah)

His honourable birth ﴿20﴾

-Damascus city in the nineteenth century

His full moon appeared over Damascus in the year 1890 on a blessed night when a Damascene tradesman had a newborn baby. The father loved his son very much because he resembled the full moon in its beauty, and for his good clever presence.

In his childhood, he was active, clever, full of motion and cheerfulness so as to create a serenity and happiness of life in the hearts of those surrounding him. Day by day he grew, and he showed an increase in cleverness and strength of personality, something which made his position greater before his parents. They venerated him and looked after him with love, affection and sympathy. But death soon snatched his affectionate father in his years of youth after an exhausting illness and tiring pain.

The death of the father had a great effect on the heart of everyone who knew him, for he left behind him a widow and two sons. Mr. Mohammad Amin had not reached seven years of age when he took responsibility for his mother’s protection, defending her and keeping her away from the evils which appeared around his family after the departure of his father from this existence, and his older brother Saleem’s travel to Turkey.

Even in his orphanage, Mohammad Amin was distinguished by his patience with the difficulties of life. He bore patience that mighty men could never bear, because he was an individual in a small respectable family that had faced many difficulties.

The sunrise of his youth &

a

glimpse of his deeds

Because of his honorable lineage that relates to the great messenger (cpth) he could approach the high responsible personalities of the ruling Turkish state at that time so that his family could reside in Sarouja Quarter which was called ‘Little Istanbul’, a dwelling place for the Turkish statesmen at that time. He also was able to study in the Royal Ottoman Faculty in Damascus, Amber.

He completed his studies when he became eighteen years old. He graduated in the rank of security officer. He surpassed his colleagues in extreme courage, trust, truth, hard work and his perseverance and continuous work with distinction. He headed many police-stations in Damascus and became director of its counties. He was the example, for no sooner had he taken his position than peace and safety prevailed in the region of his work.

He was the sleepless eye and the unmistakable arrow in the state’s quiver. Whenever the state was confronted by a criminal or a crime, they used to ask for his help. When fear, killing, corruption and criminality spread over a region, he was the saving hope, who kept off danger and liberated people.

When decay began to bite the body of the Turkish state, and the torch of Islam was quenched, corruption and chaos prevailed all over the country until crime reached an unbearable limit, living became difficult, and the days were encompassed by danger, and the darkness of the night was horrifying: except in Damascus, its countryside and suburbs, for security was prevailing as a vigilant eye was watching and a merciful heart was dedicated to peace.

He faced storms of criminals in his work with courage and boldness, and he besieged many guerrillas and arrested their leaders. All his works were crowned in victory and support until he was surnamed ‘Aslan’, meaning ‘the lion’, for his audacity in facing difficulties. By his reliance upon God, he was the only officer who stood in the face of injustice and terrorism so that the criminals and thieves used to surrender to him, fearing his bravery, to offer a plea to his justice, mercy and contentment.

Thus he advanced in the ranks and was moved among the police-stations until he was appointed director of the citadel of Damascus, which contained the warehouses and the prisons. He remained in this position for a very long time during which he achieved glories and displayed bravery that Damascus had never seen before. He was very audacious in freeing thousands of prisoners with capital sentences and putting them in the front lines to defend the country against the infidel enemy. His action was the cause of removing the gallows which were planted by Jamal Pasha, the butcher, in the marketplaces and quarters of the country and which used to swallow hundreds of young men every day. For that reason he was exposed many times to death. Thus Al’lah saved him by His Greatness, His Mercy, and His Assistance.

During the French mandate, as he was a civil security officer, he was returned to his position as the director of a district or the chief of a police-station until the great Syrian revolution took place. Due to his love for God and his noble wish to serve his country, he was the iron arm of the revolutionaries and the aorta of the revolution. Its seal was in his trustworthy hand. He disquieted the French forces with his wonderful experiments in changing retreat into victory and in giving the revolutionaries the greatest arms deal between France and the Greater Syria. He handed these arms, which the French stored in Anjar castle in Lebanon, to the revolutionaries at night. General Catro, the governor of Syria at that time, lost his mind and ordered that Mr. Mohammad Amin be executed, but the Almighty God saved him and his assistant through His Complete Words, and he turned into a very trustworthy man for them despite their error of judgment.

The stage of guidance & invitation to Al’lah

After he became forty years old, God revealed to him His Omniscience.

He began to see the recitation of the prophet (cpth) in his prayer (communication with God) of ‘Al-Fatiha‘ (the Opening) Fortress in sight and in hearing. After that he began to guide his disciples and he bore the banner of guidance in extreme strength and worthiness.

He used to be called ‘Amin Bey’ for ‘Bey’ is a Turkish word meaning ‘the pure’. His salon used to embrace the flower of youth of Syria, Lebanon, and Iraq, asking for irrigation from his Mohammadan spring, rich and generous in giving an atmosphere of haughtiness, majesty, and sanctity.

If the noble deeds were mentioned…

In our horizons…

In you the example is given…

For all of us…

A glimpse of his invitation to Al’lah, his revelation and his great guidance

His sanctified assemblies were distinguished by charming and unique revelation in perfect and plain meanings, and complete presence of reality. His words used to hit the target and fall cool and peaceful in the hearts of the listeners, as a light that bewitched them to free their spirits to soar very high.

He drove away darkness, tore asunder contradictions, and finally obliterated the intriguing schools and barren argumentations which created a big gap in the minds of people between themselves and their God. He acquainted people with the reality of God, and the consummation of His Qualities… a Merciful God, Compassionate, Wise, Fair, Conferrer of benefit, Donator, deserved to be worshipped for Himself for He is the Owner of Beauty and Consummation. It is He who is praised for any harm because this harm results in cure and donation. He is Needless of creation, and of our allegiance and our obedience, because He is Rich and we are poor and our obedience is for our own good and benefit. We need to enter His luminous fort of faith, to be protected from misfortune and adversity.

His honorable life history was a high interpretation and a clear constitution for the wonderful revelation that he brought, which contained facts for which heads bowed. The reality was a light, the form was a proof and the true practical application was a guide. His revelation was matchless in world civilizations and the positive laws of present life.

Why are we created?

What is this universe for?

What is the use of religious rituals?

What is hunger for, followed by eating in Ramadan?

What is the output and benefit of prayer?

Why do pilgrimage to a waterless and treeless desert?

Why were we brought into existence?

Where were we?

What is death for? And what is really after it?

What is the spirit?

What is the soul?

What is the mind?

What is paradise?

What is hell?

What about the problem of fate?

What is the pre-material world (the world of spirits)?

Facts and questions have not come to people’s minds because they were busy in the tempting world and its deceptions, and they forgot to search in the files of

existence and know its secrets. ﴿21﴾

-The Humane Scholar M.A. Sheikho & Sir John G.Bennett
